policy: Operator authorizes conditional daily checking of these specific official production pages; every request to a production page requires a fresh, successful robots.txt permission check in the same execution. Unavailable, denied or malformed robots.txt blocks the page; no bypass. Factual recita data only; no copied editorial content.
